description: This file contains tests for the Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint in the UI package, specifically testing the streaming of execution events via SSE, including connection handling, headers, event delivery, concurrency, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: setupTestStorage
methods.description: Creates and initializes a real storage instance for testing purposes, setting up temporary directory paths and handling cleanup.

methods.name: TestStreamExecutionEventsHandler
methods.description: Main test verifying that the SSE endpoint correctly establishes connection, sets headers, and processes published events.

methods.name: TestStreamExecutionEventsHandler_Headers
methods.description: Tests that the SSE headers are correctly set immediately after connection establishment.

methods.name: TestSSEConnectionLifecycle
methods.description: Checks that connections are closed gracefully when the context is canceled.

methods.name: TestSSEEventDelivery
methods.description: Verifies that multiple events published are delivered properly via SSE.

methods.name: TestSSEHeartbeatMechanism
methods.description: Ensures heartbeat messages (keep-alive) are sent to keep the SSE connection alive.

methods.name: TestSSEMultipleConnections
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple concurrent SSE connections independently.

methods.name: TestSSEErrorHandling
methods.description: Checks that the SSE handler manages errors gracefully under normal conditions.

methods.name: TestSSERequestValidation
methods.description: Validates that only GET requests are processed; other methods do not succeed.

methods.name: TestSSEContextCancellation
methods.description: Tests that connection is properly closed upon context cancellation.

methods.name: TestSSEConcurrentEvents
methods.description: Verifies the handler's robustness under concurrent event publishing.

methods.name: verifySSEHeaders
methods.description: Helper function to verify correct SSE response headers.

methods.name: TestSSEResponseFormat
methods.description: Confirms that SSE responses follow the correct format and contain the proper headers.

methods.name: TestSSEWithQueryParameters
methods.description: Ensures the endpoint handles query parameters gracefully, without errors.

methods.name: TestSSEConnectionReuse
methods.description: Checks that multiple connection cycles work properly, including proper cleanup and reinitialization.

methods.name: TestSSEWithInvalidStorage
methods.description: Verifies behavior when storage errors occur (via proper setup, this test confirms stability).

methods.name: TestSSEPerformance
methods.description: Measures the performance of SSE handling under rapid, bulk event publishing, ensuring non-blocking behavior.
